item.title: File Locking Libraries in 2026: filelock vs flock vs proper-lockfile
item.description: Two replicas of your self-hosted job runner wake up at 02:00. Both decide it is their turn to rebuild the nightly report. Both read the same state file, both write the same output, and by morning you have a half-written CSV plus a duplicate charge in your invoicing table. Nothing in your infrastructure was misconfigured — you simply never told the two processes that the file is a shared resource. That is a file locking problem, and it is solved in application code, not by adding another container.
